title: Prefer providing one primary experience in your iMessage app

statement.en: Favor providing one primary experience in your iMessage app when the documented conditions apply.
statement.ja: 該当条件ではproviding one primary experience in your iMessage appを優先する。

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable iMessage apps and stickers experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるiMessage apps and stickersの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

apple_native_rule: Favor providing one primary experience in your iMessage app when the documented conditions apply.
portable_interpretation: Preserve the user-centered intent after replacing Apple-specific platforms, components, and input conventions.
